initial.entityTitle: Regional membership and assisted-registration service interruption
initial.description: Staff are supporting members who cannot complete assisted registration. The notice must retain the full explanation for people who saved a partially completed form, including the distinction between an unconfirmed request and a confirmed membership, and must not promise a recovery time that has not been provided by the incident owner.
initial.subject: Assisted registration requests may need a staff review before confirmation
initial.message: Requests saved during the interruption remain in the review queue. A saved request does not yet establish a confirmed membership. Staff should locate the original reference, explain the current status in plain language, and avoid asking a member to enter the same details repeatedly while the regional team checks the queue.

audiences.label: Notify affected customers
audiences.detail: Customers with bookings awaiting confirmation need a direct explanation and a usable next step.
audiences.blockedReason: Direct customer wording has not been approved

audiences.label: Notify service staff
audiences.detail: Regional service staff, assisted-registration volunteers, and the named support coordinator need the full operational explanation for their next member conversation.

audiences.label: Notify partner offices
audiences.detail: Partner offices have no affected bookings in this incident.
